title: 5.4 How Many? and Some
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Ask How many ... are there? and answer with there are and a number; say there is some ... about food and drinks.
grammar_function: How many + plural noun + are there? There are three apples. There is some rice.
prerequisite: 4.4 there is and there are; 2.6-2.7 numbers; 5.1-5.3 fruit, food and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Ask How many ... are there? and answer; say There is some ....
